meta_description:
214 likes, 22 comments - cookieandkate on October 26, 2026: "If you’re looking to save money by making a barista-style drink at home, or for seasonal drinks that don’t include coffee, this is the perfect recipe for you: this homemade pumpkin chai latte. It’s a creamy, maple-sweetened latte made with real pumpkin and chai tea, with a blend of warming spices.⁠

Find the full recipe on my website at the link in the bio, or comment “save” and I’ll send it to you.

https://cookieandkate.com/homemade-pumpkin-chai-latte/".
